diagram_paradigm.intent: EvoDiagram coordinates structure, style, and layout agents to create editable diagrams, while refinement experience evolves the design knowledge that guides subsequent generation.
diagram_paradigm.primary_organizer: Role-based component tiers with a generation path and a knowledge evolution feedback path.
diagram_paradigm.recognition_anchor: Distinct agent components, a canvas rendering loop, and shared design expertise memory.

fact_ledger.evidence: The structure agent distills source content into a semantic graph aligned with user queries.
The visual style agent defines aesthetic properties of the semantic topology G.
The layout agent maps styled semantic elements onto a two-dimensional coordinate system.

fact_ledger.predicate: provides the completed manifest for rendering by
fact_ledger.evidence: After adding library metadata, the system executes deterministic rendering of the representation manifest.

fact_ledger.predicate: provides the rendered canvas for diagnosis by
fact_ledger.evidence: The refinement agent identifies discrepancies that emerge post-rendering.
The refiner invokes precision tools for single-element updates, rerouting, and alignment.
Rendering within the canvas environment produces an interactive visual artifact.
Vertical exploration captures the reasoning path through iterative refiner thoughts, fixes, and feedback.
The summarizer filters logs from hybrid experience search for subsequent knowledge distillation.
Newly collected strategies pass through distillation and are incrementally merged into M.
Each agent retrieves tailored context-aware heuristics; the structure agent uses tailored knowledge.
The visual style agent uses retrieved knowledge Ksty.
The spatial layout agent uses knowledge Klay.

topological_invariants: Preserve the Structure Agent → Style Agent → Layout Agent generation order and their shared canvas schema.
Preserve both directions of the rendering–refinement cycle as distinct source facts.
Preserve the experience search → distillation → memory feedback path and memory retrieval by all three generation agents.
Every node participates in at least one edge; no groups or visible edge labels are required.
CanvasBench, experimental baselines, and auxiliary implementation tools are outside the framework overview scope.

node_fields.role: Architectural role for downstream tier assignment.

edge_fields.relation: Exact semantic predicate from the fact ledger.
edge_fields.evidence_basis: Explicit source support for each selected relationship.

schema_extensions.knowledge_abstraction: Memory tiers are summarized within one memory component; distillation stages are summarized within one distiller.
